name: John B. De Leon
office: Baldwin Park Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: John B. de Leon is a member of the Baldwin Park Unified School District Board of Education. He is a state attorney. On the board, he created and supported a districtwide reading initiative, the Jackie Robinson Reading Challenge, in which students read millions of words. He says the district implemented a science-based reading curriculum and achieved literacy gains. He supports expanding learning opportunities, including both college preparation and career technical education courses.
